test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The audience is applauding the wonderful performance.

options.text: The wonderful audience is being applauded by the performance.
The wonderful performance was being applauded by the audience.
The wonderful performance is being applauded by the audience.
The wonderful performance is applauded by the audience.

solution:
​The correct answer is** '****The wonderful performance is being applauded by the audience'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in the Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change the sentence into Passive Voice. 
 
• The given sentence is an example of 'present continuous'. 
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
• Subject + is/am/are + V1 + ing + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject(Objective Case) + is/am/are + being+ V3 + by + Objec
